subject: Proposed MAP + Evaluation Milestones — BrightLoop pilot (pricing & bundles)
messages:
From: Grace Lim <grace@brightloop.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot scope follow-up

Thanks for the demo today, Priyom — we liked the throughput numbers and the observability screenshots.

Before we get internal buy-in I need a proposed evaluation plan and a clear path to production (pricing and timeline). Can you put together: 
- A short MAP with milestones tied to discount/credits
- Success metrics for the 2-week pilot and what constitutes a successful ramp to 50K tokens/day
- Any bundle options (observability retention increase, premium support add-ons) and their incremental cost

We have a weekly exec review on Friday; would be great to have a one-page MAP by Wednesday EOD so I can circulate.

Best,
Grace Lim
VP of Engineering | BrightLoop
[Attachment: BrightLoop_poc_requirements.pdf (PDF, 68 KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Lim <grace@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + pilot success criteria — BrightLoop

Grace — thanks for the quick note and the clear ask. Attached is a one-page MAP and a pricing sheet with two commercial paths. Highlights below: 

MAP (attached PDF):
- Week 0: Contract signature + onboarding (gate: signed SOW)
- Week 1-2: Evaluation pilot (2 weeks): 1000 queries/day simulating production mix; success = 95th pctl latency < 300ms and qualitative parity on 3 test prompts
- Week 3-6: Ramp to 50K tokens/day (can be accelerated with dedicated capacity)
- Week 7: GA readiness review and reserved commit discussion

Commercial ties to MAP:
- Pilot pricing: complimentary credits (10k generation tokens + 5k embedding tokens) if MAP milestones completed and success metrics met
- Ramp discount: 15% off on committed throughput for 3 months once 50K tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days
- Commitment bonus: additional observability retention (90 days) included for 12 months if they sign a 12-month reserved capacity contract

Bundling options called out in pricing_sheet_Redwood_v3.xlsx (attached):
- Observability retention upgrade (30 -> 90 days): $X/month or included as commitment bonus
- Premium support (24/7) add-on: flat fee + per-incident credit bucket
- Add-on inference credits: bulk discounts at 10%, 20% thresholds

Attachments: MAP_BrightLoop_v1.pdf, pricing_sheet_Redwood_v3.xlsx, observability_retention_matrix.csv

Next steps: I recommend a 30-minute call Wednesday morning so I can walk the execs through the MAP before your Friday review. Aditya — tagging you for approver note on the concession (15% ramp discount + 90-day retention as commitment bonus).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: MAP_BrightLoop_v1.pdf (PDF, 152 KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Grace Lim <grace@brightloop.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + pilot success criteria — BrightLoop

Priyom — quick confirmation from my side: we can approve the following promotional terms for this pilot given BrightLoop's strategic fit and expected volume ramp: 
- Pilot credit package as proposed (no charge)
- Ramp discount: 15% for first 3 months after hitting 50K tokens/day
- Commitment bonus: include 90-day observability retention for the first 12 months if they sign 12-month reserved capacity within 30 days of GA readiness

Conditions:
- All of the above contingent on the MAP success criteria being documented and validated by our SRE during the pilot
- Any deeper pricing concessions require Finance approval (we can revisit at contract stage)

Grace — happy to join the Wed AM call for a 10–15 minute commercial summary if helpful. Priyom, loop Monica for onboarding coordination and billing flow.

Aditya Rao
Head of Sales — Americas | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: approval_note_internal.txt (TXT, 2 KB)]

From: Grace Lim <grace@brightloop.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + pilot success criteria — BrightLoop

Thanks — this looks good and is aligned with our expectations. A couple quick clarifications before I present to execs: 
- Can the observability retention bonus be shown on the pricing sheet as a line item (so finance can see the value)?
- For premium support, we likely only need the onboarding SLA for the first 6 weeks — can that be scoped as a temporary add-on rather than full 24/7?

We have a mid-day slot Thursday for your walkthrough (11:00 PT). Please send the calendar invite and the one-page MAP PDF in the invite. After exec review we will route the PO to procurement; I will include a procurement contact in the thread once execs approve.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Grace
VP of Engineering | BrightLoop
